data.summary: Results-driven Technology Change & Transformation professional with 15+ years of experience spanning IT controls, operational risk, reconciliation and Billing (ORMB) platform transformation, and cross-regional programs at BNY Mellon, Citibank, and Webster Bank. Proven track record continually reassessing operational risk against regulatory requirements, operating procedures, and technology change; driving AI-enabled automation and process re-engineering that lifts throughput and consistency without compromising control quality; and producing requirement, training, and process- education material for cross-functional teams. Adept at partnering with Business, Client, and Technology stakeholders to uphold data integrity, SLA compliance, and audit-ready documentation across US, Asia, LATAM, and CEEMEA.

experience.role: AVP - Senior Specialist, Business Technology Liaison Reconciliation
responsibilities: Led end-to-end daily, weekly, and monthly Cash, Position, and Digital Asset reconciliation transformation project across Custody, Fund Accounting, Middle Office, and AIS, for fixed income, financing, and related products. ensuring completion before trading-hour start for respective global regions.
Managed new client onboarding, match and RAF rules validation on the reconciliation platform.
Led end-to-end TLM (Smart Stream) upgrade implementation, mapping, config set up, and support

Drove reconciliation automation and AI-enabled capabilities initiative spanning multiple accounting & external system (Oracle GL, FTS, Geneva, GSP, Treasury Edge, Invest One/FIS), Transtar) reducing operational risk and manual data load.
Acted as primary liaison between Business, Client and technology team
Recognized for process improvement expertise, Agile delivery, executive stakeholder management, and building high-performing teams that deliver transformative results.

Managed and mentored a team of 6 junior analyst, overseeing multiple transformation initiatives within reconciliation, mentoring and coaching cross-functional operation team to foster professional growth and operational excellence.
Liaised with custodians on escalation matrix and resolving breaks, trade settlements and data load issues; maintained ongoing custodian relationships to uphold data integrity and SLA compliance.

Managed and Established Feed Monitoring Dashboard product for tracking feed time discrepancy and data load issues for reconciliation, also performed Unknown Data Cleansing which accelerated early reconciliation and NAV calculation which helped business team to perform their daily task early.

Led end to end data cleanup for RDZ data platform leading to reduction of 10 million unknown data load to reconciliation platform and performed data migration project for reconciliation technology team from legacy system to new system. Expert in STP process integration and file interface configuration leading to removal of manual touch point.
Defined Business Requirement Documents, workflows, UAT, SIT test strategy, test cases, and validation criteria for internal and external data migration to the RDZ data platform via NDM/SFTP.

Maintained project artifacts including charters, integrated timelines, RAID logs, and action item trackers across all reconciliation workstreams; documented user stories and process flow in JIRA and Confluence.

Continually reassessed operational risks in line with regulatory requirements, operating procedures, and technology changes, applying change-governance discipline to escalation and oversight processes.
Led end-to-end data migration from Central Data Repository (CDR / Oracle) to AWS-based Webster Data Repository (WDR) using Snowflake, ensuring data quality and regulatory compliance throughout.
Managed migration of SAP Business Objects reports to Tableau, delivering modern self-service BI capabilities for business users.

Defined business requirements, led UAT testing, and developed process flows to enhance system integration efficiency; provided training on new platform SOPs. Delivered cloud-based reporting architecture and modern BI capability, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organisation.

experience.role: System Engineer - Project Manager, Global Billing Analytics (CIB) / Cash Operations
responsibilities: Led end-to-end ORMB product on boarding implementation and rollout activities within Trade and Treasury Solutions, serving as Subject Matter Expert for ISO 20022 Global Billing platform including TWIST XML/BSB, CAMT.086, EDI 822, and CSS format reports across US, Canada, Asia, LATAM, and CEEMEA regions.
Acted as primary liaison between Business, Client and technology.

Conducted walkthroughs and testing discussions with senior stakeholders, technology team during weekly and monthly business review calls. Responsible for preparation and timely presentation of varies reports such as, Cap Plan, MIS, KPI, Ad hoc Tracker and various audits documents and reports
Led a team of 4 team members, fostering a culture of compliance, accountability, and operational excellence.
Championed an inclusive mentoring culture across all staff levels, promoting skill development and engagement

Executed comprehensive UAT, SIT, Functional, and Regression testing cycles for ORMB and enterprise billing platforms, validating billing configurations, pricing calculations, invoicing workflows, payment processing, and financial transaction accuracy across multiple parallel environments.
Defined test scope, reviewed business requirements, and coordinated defect resolution across SIT, UAT, and Regression phases in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
Performed backend validation using Oracle SQL for billing data reconciliation and pricing accuracy checks; supported API and integration validation for billing system interfaces.
Managed client onboarding, UAT sign-off coordination, and end-to-end validation for global billing invoices and reports, acting as primary liaison between Technology and Operations teams.

Led multiple platform re-engineering and automation initiatives across ORMB, GCAR, ECIF, Vanguard Big Data, IGS, and CRM notification distribution, significantly reducing manual reporting effort and improving data accuracy.

Managed production support including issue triaging, root cause analysis, and release validation for Global Statements delivery, ensuring data integrity across multi-region billing operations. Reduced manual reporting effort, improved data accuracy, and enhanced client invoicing and reporting quality across 4+ global regions.
Managed Citi Mortgage Loss Mitigation Program under FHA, VA, FHLMC, and FNMA guidelines; prepared MIS, KPI, and audit reports ensuring SLA compliance.
Trained and mentored new employees on loan modifications, HAMP, short sale programs, and financial documentation requirements.

experience.company: Intelenet Global Services Pvt. Ltd. (Barclays Central Telephony)
responsibilities: Resolved inbound customer queries across Online Banking, Branch Banking, and Funds Transfers; mentored new joiners on COPC guidelines.
Awarded Best Advisor for 100% RBSM Quality Scores (Oct and Nov 2009).
Handled reservations, cancellations, and ticket reissues; trained on IATA, Galileo, and CRM platforms.
Recognised as Rep of the Quarter (2005).
